decision_basis: The frozen GPT-5-mini known-answer reproduction failed, Gemini was promising only on already-unsealed diagnostic data and never abstained, the one-session native-Cosmos causal screen failed and correctly triggered abstention, and no valid whole-stack closed-loop Phase B, independently anchored captured-site transfer, or useful end-to-end economics comparison was completed. The current negative WAM screen is underpowered and therefore cannot by itself falsify the replaceable Blueprint thesis.

cosmos_wam_qualification.basis: On one label-blind disjoint session, native Cosmos passed 1/10 active scene-response comparisons, 2/10 temporal-placebo comparisons, and 0/5 both-seed robustness conditions. The tier-1 gate found five hard-failure windows and session-median timing correlation 0.021936 versus 0.15 required. Blueprint correctly abstained, but one session is below the 17-session prospective target.

frozen_benchmark_calibration.basis: Across 63 sessions, seven policies, and 441 episodes, GPT-5 mini achieved Spearman 0.357143, Kendall tau-b 0.238095, policy pairwise accuracy 0.619048 with clustered interval [0.428571, 0.857143], selective coverage 0.050182, and selective pairwise accuracy 0.600000. Gemini 3.6 Flash achieved 0.75, 0.619048, and 0.809524 respectively, but only after label unseal and with zero abstentions.

captured_site_transfer.basis: Phase C was not admitted. No Blueprint 3DGS/site adapter was run through this frozen stack and no independently attributable physical outcomes existed for the same site, task, embodiment, and policies.

economics_and_speed.basis: Attributable digital costs were measured, but no WAM arm completed a useful ranking and no defensible physical monetary or robot-hour baseline was available. Therefore no speed ratio, cost ratio, or break-even policy count is claimed.

wam_arms.historical_oscar_baseline: Experiment 2 remains thesis_not_supported for its frozen OSCAR-derived stack; visible skeleton evidence did not survive scene masking.

cheapest_scientifically_valid_next_exper: First run the hash-pinned official NVIDIA AgiBotWorld positive control to distinguish deployment failure from DROID-contract failure, with zero DROID requests on a positive-control failure. If it passes, run the already-frozen DROID diagnostic and then require a genuinely new powered independent-session set before full-episode ranking. The positive-control result itself cannot earn qualification credit.
status_note: This verdict is an interim evidence snapshot. Its overall verdict and completed-result claims remain valid while the prospectively frozen positive-control bisection is pending.
